This case-sensitive code system https://dsacms.github.io/cmmi-access-model/CodeSystem/ACCESSReportDataCompositionSectionCS defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
QuickDASH Quick Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand [QuickDASH]Assesses physical function and symptoms in people with upper limb musculoskeletal disorders
WHODAS World Health Organization Disability Assessment Schedule [WHODAS] 2.0Assesses functioning and disability across six life domains: cognition, mobility, self-care, getting along, life activities, and participation.
PGIC Patient Global Impression of Change [PGIC]Assesses patient's perception of improvement or decline.
